segments.text: solid. They wobble a bit, so be gentle with them. Similarly, this is an evaporating dish.

segments.text: Sometimes you may need to let a wet solid sit and dry. We can use an evaporating dish for this.
segments.zh: 有时你可能需要让湿的固体静置晾干，这时可以用蒸发皿。

segments.text: They are typically ceramic and have high edges. Now this little thing is a melting point tube.

segments.zh: 测定熔点时，你需要熔点管。它们看起来像小小的

segments.text: Another indispensable piece of equipment is the scale, or balance. Scales are used to weigh
segments.zh: 另一件必不可少的设备是秤，也就是天平。天平用来准确称量

segments.text: the mass of solids accurately. Be sure to tear the scale with any vessel you are weighing.

segments.text: What this means is that whatever will hold the solid, we can place it on the balance and zero
segments.zh: 意思是，无论用什么来盛放固体，我们都可以把它放在天平上，把

segments.text: the mass, so that the measurement we take correlates precisely with the solid that is added.
segments.zh: 质量归零，这样我们测得的读数就正好对应加入的固体。

segments.text: Make sure to avoid pouring or scooping the solid onto the vessel while it is on the scales,
segments.zh: 一定要避免在容器放在天平上时往里倒或舀固体，
